# JelNusa

> JelNusa is an Indonesia-focused travel discovery and planning platform at https://jelnusa.com/. It helps travelers discover destinations, hidden gems, practical travel guidance, itinerary ideas, and AI-assisted trip planning with NUSA.

## Canonical identity
- Name: JelNusa
- Website: https://jelnusa.com/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jelnusa
- Contact: arifmuhamad94@gmail.com
- Primary topic: travel discovery and trip planning for Indonesia
- Supported interface languages: English, Indonesian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Dutch, Thai

## NUSA
NUSA is JelNusa's AI travel assistant. It can help with destination ideas, itineraries, budget guidance, packing, and general travel questions. NUSA does not make bookings or process payments.

## Travel information
Travel conditions, prices, schedules, entry rules, closures, weather, and local policies can change. Important details should be verified with current official or authoritative sources before travel.

## Partner and affiliate links
JelNusa may use approved partner or affiliate links. Bookings, payments, cancellations, refunds, availability, and service delivery are handled by the third-party provider.

## Editorial scope
JelNusa focuses on useful, destination-specific travel information for Indonesia. It is not a hotel, airline, tour operator, travel agency, booking provider, government authority, emergency service, or official travel authority.
